steps: Historical citations and ambient-current discussion supply no premise for the new construction.
The even product mollifier gives Jensen's lower bound max t_i, the stated upper bound (indeed max t_i+delta suffices), convexity, monotonicity, smoothness on R^N and translation equivariance.
An entry separated from the maximum by more than 2delta cannot affect any maximum in the integration region; integrating out that entry returns exactly the remaining-variable regularization.

Differentiating translation equivariance gives sum_i partial_i M=1; the Hessian is positive semidefinite, so the chain rule preserves a common smooth (1,1) lower bound without requiring that lower bound to be closed.

Closedness of zeta gives local smooth ddbar potentials for gamma_0=-zeta. A fixed sufficiently fine finite nested coordinate cover can be chosen so intersecting shrunken balls have their enlarged balls in a common original coordinate ball, using a Lebesgue number.
psi_j=phi-h_j is psh. Coordinate Lebesgue measures are chosen independently of phi,zeta,m and have bounded smooth density ratios on compact overlaps.

Local upper bounds on psi_j give bounded holomorphic evaluation and derivative functionals on the Hilbert space; the Bergman sum converges smoothly locally. Its logarithm is psh and smooth where the kernel is positive.
Adding h_j restores zeta+ddc phi_jm>=0. Identification and properness of the zero set are deferred to Step 4 and do not depend on Step 3.

On simply connected coordinate balls h_j-H_jl=Re a_j. Since psi_j=Psi-Re a_j, f -> exp(m a_j/2) f is an isometry to the common-weight Hilbert space. Its kernel is exp(m Re a_j)K_jm, yielding phi_jm=Psi_jm+H_jl with the correct sign.
The compact overlap is contained in the open intersection, so a cutoff equal to one near it exists and its derivative support has a positive uniform distance r from every x in that overlap.

The singular weight mPsi+2d log|z-x|+|z|^2 is psh with uniform positive Euclidean Levi lower bound. The cutoff datum is closed and has a uniformly bounded weighted norm by r^{-2d}, fixed derivative bounds, and coordinate-volume comparison.
The inequality |z-x|<=R and bounded |z| on the target ball convert the singular weighted estimate into a usual e^{-mPsi} norm bound with no dependence on m,Psi,x.

Near x, the datum vanishes and g is holomorphic. Local boundedness above of Psi implies integrability of |g|^2|z-x|^{-2d}; a nonzero constant term would give radial integral integral_0^epsilon rho^{-1}drho, so g(x)=0.

F=theta f-g is holomorphic, preserves f(x), and has uniformly bounded target norm. Taking the supremum of |f(x)|^2 and reversing j,l gives a uniform multiplicative kernel comparison and hence the additive C_B/m estimate, including common zeros via extended inequalities.
Compactness gives fixed smooth cutoffs and a common lower Levi bound relative to omega_Z. At a boundary point of V_j choose U_l containing it; on a smaller neighborhood chi_j=0 and chi_l=1.

The overlap error is C_B/m while the bump advantage is (C_B+1)/m; the remaining margin 1/m exceeds 2delta=1/(2m). Therefore the outgoing branch is absent from the regularized maximum wherever branches are finite.

Step 4 establishes that all locally present branches equal -infinity on exactly the same proper analytic set. Values also agree there when a branch is removed. Finitely many such removals give a fixed local finite-branch expression.

The chain rule off the zero set preserves zeta+ddc phi_m>=-A omega_Z with A=(C_B+1)C_chi/m. Local smoothness of the kernels gives local upper bounds and convergence of all branches to -infinity at their common zeros.
On a smaller ball choose a smooth quadratic q with ddc q dominating the negative lower bound. Then phi_m+q is psh off the analytic set and extends; its limit value there is -infinity.

The extended positive current T=ddc(phi_m+q) has measure coefficients. With beta=ddc q-zeta-A omega_Z, T-beta is positive off the analytic set. That set has zero smooth volume, so (T-beta) restricted to it equals the positive restriction of T. Hence the original smooth lower bound holds globally, even though omega_Z is not closed.
The coefficient A uses only the fixed-cover constants C_B and C_chi. The local auxiliary quadratic may depend on zeta but contributes no loss to the final inequality.
Finite Hilbert norm implies local integrability with weight e^{-mpsi_j}; smooth h_j does not affect the multiplier ideal.

The invoked DEL00 result must be checked with varphi_DEL=(m/2)psi_j so its e^{-2varphi_DEL} weight is exactly e^{-mpsi_j}, using Euclidean Kähler volume on the source ball and its larger psh neighborhood.
Assuming that precisely stated generation theorem, the ideal generated by the Hilbert basis is I(mphi) on V_j. This supplies the common zero set used in Step 3 without circularity.

A psh weight is finite almost everywhere; at a finite point its Lelong number is zero, hence its finite-multiple multiplier ideal is nonzero somewhere by local integrability. Coherence on connected Z then makes its zero locus a proper analytic subset.

Noetherian stalks and coherence give a finite subset of basis elements generating on a neighborhood of x. K>=sum of their squared norms gives phi_jm>=m^{-1}psi_I+O(1), with smooth h_j absorbed locally.
Choose x in U_j and shrink inside it. Nonnegative bumps and M>=each entry imply phi_m>=phi_jm, proving the stated one-sided bound only.

A nonzero coherent ideal on a connected complex manifold is nonzero generically, so its zero set is proper analytic. Finite local holomorphic generating sets and nested coordinate balls exist by coherence and compactness.

On compact overlaps, each generating vector is a local holomorphic matrix times the other. A finite compact subcover bounds the matrices in both directions, giving two-sided log-squared-norm comparison off the common zeros and its natural extended interpretation on them.
The preceding gluing and extension argument applies with m=1, psh logarithmic branches, delta=1/4, and yields a global quasi-psh function smooth off the zero locus.

The regularized-maximum inequalities and bounded bumps yield locally Psi_a=log(sum|g_i|^2)+O(1). This proves analytic ideal type (1,a) under the supplied source's bounded-remainder convention; the exact convention remains to be verified.

structuredContent.query: Demailly regularization of closed positive currents: given a closed real (1,1) current T=alpha+ddc phi on a compact complex manifold with T>=gamma for a smooth real (1,1) form gamma and a Hermitian metric omega, there are regularizations T_k=alpha+ddc phi_k with analytic singularities and T_k>=gamma-epsilon_k omega, epsilon_k decreasing to zero. SGPT Theorem 1.6.2 additionally prescribes singularity type (1/k,I(k phi)). Dem92 and DPS01.

results.title: Kähler-Einstein metrics on stable varieties and log canonical pairs
results.theorem:
Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold of dimension $n$, $dV$ some volume form, $D=\sum a_{i}D_{i}$ a $\mathbb{R}$-divisor with coefficients in $(-\infty,1]$ and defining sections $s_{i}$, $E=\sum c_{\alpha}E_{\alpha}$ an effective $\mathbb{R}$-divisor such that $D_{red}+E$ has snc support, and $\theta$ a semipositive form with $\int_{X}\theta^{n}>0$ such that $\{\theta\}-c_{1}(E)$ is a Kähler class. Then the $\theta$-psh function $\varphi$ with full Monge-Ampère mass, which is a solution of



$\langle(\theta+dd^{c}\phi)^{n}\rangle=\frac{e^{\varphi}dV}{\prod_{i}|s_{i}|^{2a_{j}}}$



is smooth outside of $\mathrm{Supp}(D)\cup\mathrm{Supp}(E)$.

results.title: Metrics with cone singularities along normal crossing divisors and holomorphic tensor fields
results.theorem:
Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold and $D=\sum(1-\tau_{j})Y_{j}$ a divisor with simple normal crossings such that its coefficients satisfy $0<\tau_{j}\leqslant 1/2$. Let $\mu_{D}=dV/\prod_{j}|s_{j}|^{2(1-\tau_{j})}$ be a volume form with cone singularities along $D$, $\psi$ a bounded quasi-psh function, and $\omega$ a Kähler form on $X$. Then any (bounded) solution $\varphi$ of



$(\omega+dd^{c}\varphi)^{n}=e^{-\psi}\mu_{D}$



is Hölder-continuous and the metric $\omega+dd^{c}\varphi$ has cone singularities along $D$.

results.title: Almost scalar-flat Kähler metrics on affine algebraic manifolds
results.theorem:
For arbitrary $\eta=(\eta_{1},...,\eta_{p})\in(0,+\infty)^{p}$, the function



$M_{\eta}(t_{1},...,t_{p})=\int_{\mathbb{R}^{p}}\max\{t_{1}+h_{1},...,t_{p}+h_{p}\}\prod_{1\leq j\leq p}\eta_{j}^{-1}\rho(h_{j}/\eta_{j})dh_{1}...dh_{p}$



called the regularized maximum possesses the following properties $:$

a)


$M_{\eta}(t_{1},...,t_{p})$ is non decreasing in all variables, smooth and convex on $\mathbb{R}^{p}\hskip 2.0pt;$


b)


$\max\{t_{1},...,t_{p}\}\leq M_{\eta}(t_{1},...,t_{p})\leq\max\{t_{1}+\eta_{1},...,t_{p}+\eta_{p}\}\hskip 2.0pt;$


c)


$M_{\eta}(t_{1},...,t_{p})=M_{(\eta_{1},...,\hat{\eta_{j}},...,\eta_{p})}(t_{1},...,\hat{t_{j}},...,t_{p})$ if $t_{j}+\eta_{j}\leq\max_{k\neq j}\{t_{k}-\eta_{k}\}\hskip 2.0pt;$


d)


$M_{\eta}(t_{1}+a,...,t_{p}+a)=M_{\eta}(t_{1},...,t_{p})+a\hskip 2.0pt;$


e)


if $u_{1},...,u_{p}$ are plurisubharmonic and satisfy $H(u_{j})_{z}(\xi)\geq\gamma_{z}(\xi)$ where $z\mapsto\gamma_{z}$ is a continuous hermitian form on $TM$, then $u=M_{\eta}(u_{1},...,u_{p})$ is a plurisubharmonic and satisfies $Hu_{z}(\xi)\geq\gamma_{z}(\xi)$.

results.title: Optimal $L^2$ extension for holomorphic vector bundles with singular hermitian metrics
results.theorem:
Let $\Omega$ be a pseudoconvex domain in $\mathbb{C}^{n}$, and $\varphi$ be a plurisubharmonic function on $\Omega$. For any $w\in L^{2}_{p,q+1}(\Omega,e^{-\varphi})$ with $\bar{\partial}w=0$, there exists a solution $s\in L^{2}_{p,q}(\Omega,e^{-\varphi})$ of the equation $\bar{\partial}s=w$ such that



$\int_{\Omega}\frac{|s|^{2}}{(1+|z|^{2})^{2}}e^{-\varphi}d\lambda\leq\int_{\Omega}|w|^{2}e^{-\varphi}d\lambda,$



where $d\lambda$ is the Lebesgue measure on $\mathbb{C}^{n}$.

results.title: A Remark on Optimal $L^2$ extension theorem for holomorphic vector bundles
results.theorem:
Let $\Omega$ be a pseudoconvex domain in $\mathbb{C}^{n}$, and $\varphi$ be a plurisubharmonic function on $\Omega$. For any $w\in L^{2}_{p,q+1}(\Omega,e^{-\varphi})$ with $\bar{\partial}w=0$, there exists a solution $s\in L^{2}_{p,q}(\Omega,e^{-\varphi})$ of the equation $\bar{\partial}s=w$ such that



$\int_{\Omega}\frac{|s|^{2}}{(1+|z|^{2})^{2}}e^{-\varphi}d\lambda\leq\int_{\Omega}|w|^{2}e^{-\varphi}d\lambda,$



where $d\lambda$ is the Lebesgue measure on $\mathbb{C}^{n}$.

results.title: Supplement to $L^2$ theory of $\bar{\partial}$ on complete Kähler domains
results.theorem:
Let $\Omega$ be a complete Kähler domain in ${\mathbb{C}}^{n}$, and $\varphi$ a psh function on $\Omega$ satisfying $i\partial\bar{\partial}\varphi\geq\Theta$ in the sense of distributions for some Kähler form $\Theta$ on $\Omega$. For any $\bar{\partial}-$closed $(0,1)$ form $v$ with $\int_{\Omega}|v|^{2}e^{-\varphi}<\infty$ and
$\int_{\Omega}|v|^{2}_{\Theta}e^{-\varphi}<\infty,$
there exists $u\in L^{2}(\Omega,{\rm loc})$ such that $\bar{\partial}u=v$ and



$\int_{\Omega}|u|^{2}e^{-\varphi}\leq\int_{\Omega}|v|^{2}_{\Theta}e^{-\varphi}.$

results.title: Optimal $L^2$ Extensions of Openness Type
results.theorem:
Let $\Omega\subset{\mathbb{C}}^{n}$ be a bounded pseudoconvex domain, $S\subset\Omega$ be a closed submanifold of codimension $p$ and $\varphi$ be a psh function on $\Omega$. Let $G_{\Omega,S}$ be the pluricomplex Green function of $\Omega$ with singularities along $S$. Assume that $G_{\Omega,S}\not\equiv-\infty$. Let $m\in{\mathbb{N}}$ and $a\in{\mathbb{R}}_{+}$ be given, let $U=\{G_{\Omega,S}<-a\}$. For any $f\in A^{2}(U;e^{-\varphi})$, there exists a holomorphic function $F\in A^{2}(\Omega;e^{-\varphi})$ such that $F$ coincides with $f$ up to order $m$ along $S$ and



$\int_{\Omega}|F|^{2}e^{-\varphi}d\lambda\leqslant e^{2(p+m)a}\int_{U}|f|^{2}e^{-\varphi}d\lambda.$

results.title: Automorphism groups of $P^1$-bundles over a non-uniruled base
results.theorem:
[Siu extension Theorem] Let $X$ be a complex manifold, $A$ be a subvariety of codimension $\geq 1$ in $X,$ and
$G$ be an open subset of $X$ which intersect every branch of $A$ of codimension 1. If $M$ is a compact Kähler manifold, then every meromorphic map $f$ from $(X-A)\cup G$ may be extended to a meromorphic map from $X$ to $M.$

Les hypothèses et les notations étant celles du

reference_checks.location: Regularized maximum — DemCADG Chapter I, Lemma 5.18
reference_checks.referenced_statement: Demailly Complex Analytic and Differential Geometry Chapter I Lemma 5.18: the convolution regularized maximum M_eta is smooth, convex, nondecreasing in each variable, lies between max t_j and max(t_j+eta_j), satisfies M_eta(t+c)=M_eta(t)+c, and is independent of t_j if t_j+eta_j is less than max of the other t_k-eta_k; it preserves a common Levi lower bound.
reference_checks.context_expansion: ArXiv search returned matching regularized-maximum properties (e.g. arXiv 1908.05583, Lemma 2.8); the cited original was inspected directly. The source uses a centered nonnegative compactly supported smoothing kernel. Its displayed formula omits normalization factors in the available manuscript, whereas the submitted product delta^{-1}vartheta(tau_i/delta) has the correct probability normalization, for which the listed properties follow directly. Equal parameters eta_i=delta give an upper bound max t_i+delta, so the submitted weaker max t_i+Ndelta is valid. Property (e) concerns a continuous Hermitian Levi lower bound; closedness is not required. The proof supplies the smooth quasi-psh chain-rule specialization explicitly.
reference_checks.downstream_application: Translation invariance and convexity preserve the entire common smooth lower form; the 2delta dominance criterion gives exact branch removal in Step 3.

reference_checks.location: Step 2 — singular Hörmander estimate, DemCADG Chapter VIII, section 6
reference_checks.referenced_statement: Classical singular Hörmander L2 theorem on a pseudoconvex domain in C^n: if Phi is plurisubharmonic, possibly singular, and i partial barpartial Phi >= i partial barpartial |z|^2, every distributionally barpartial-closed (0,1)-form v with finite integral |v|^2 exp(-Phi) against Euclidean volume admits barpartial g=v with integral |g|^2 exp(-Phi) <= C_n integral |v|^2 exp(-Phi). Demailly Complex Analytic and Differential Geometry Chapter VIII section 6.

reference_checks.context_expansion: Search returned related singular L2 estimates, followed by inspection of the cited book. Theorem (6.5) supplies the smooth-weight curvature estimate. In Euclidean coordinates the trivial bundle and canonical top form have zero curvature/Ricci correction. The singular-weight passage is justified by convolution on increasing pseudoconvex subdomains and weak limits, as explicitly described after Theorem (6.9); convolution preserves the fixed strictly positive Levi bound, so the same fixed curvature constant remains available.
reference_checks.downstream_application: Take the target Euclidean ball, the scalar exponent Phi=mPsi+2d log|z-x|+|z|^2, and v=(barpartial theta)f. Its support is separated from x and its weighted squared norm is uniformly finite. All required hypotheses hold and the resulting C_H depends only on Euclidean normalizations/dimension.

reference_checks.context_expansion: ArXiv theorem search returned no matching result; primary author-book web fallback and the supplied local PDF verify the extension theorem. It is local on complex manifolds and needs no Kähler metric.
reference_checks.downstream_application: Apply after adding a local quadratic Q. The limit at the common zero set is -infinity, so extension gives the prescribed function. Let A=(C_B+1)C_chi/m, T=ddc(phi_m+Q)>=0, and beta=ddc Q-zeta-A omega_Z. T-beta is positive off the analytic set. On that set its measure restriction equals the positive restriction of T because beta is smooth and the analytic set has zero volume. Thus the exact original lower bound holds globally, even with nonclosed omega_Z.

reference_checks.referenced_statement: For psh phi on a complex manifold X, let U be relatively compact Stein with a basis of Stein neighborhoods of its closure, and let dV be Kähler volume near that closure. Then J(phi)|U is generated as an O_U module by an orthonormal Hilbert basis of holomorphic f with integral_U |f|^2 exp(-2phi)dV finite.
reference_checks.search_evidence: Independent reference agent queried search_arxiv_theorems first; after an initial timeout, retry returned exact Proposition 1.2, math/0002035. Primary source was inspected.
reference_checks.context_expansion: Set X=B_j^+, U=B_j, phi_DEL=(m/2)psi_j, dV=dλ_j. Exponents agree exactly. Slightly larger concentric balls inside B_j^+ give Stein neighborhoods of the closure; Euclidean volume is Kähler there.
reference_checks.downstream_application: Generation is by the same orthonormal basis defining K_jm. Smooth h_j leaves the multiplier ideal unchanged. This gives the common zero set independently of gluing. Noetherianity and coherence give a finite subset of basis generators near each point. Comparing K with their sum of squared norms gives the lower singularity bound; nonnegative bumps and maximum domination transfer it to phi_m.
